review:
A farmyard where hens sit above each reel and drop eggs at random. Three eggs in one spin trigger the bonus.

Before free spins, three more eggs appear on each reel that had one, revealing 1–3 spins, a prize up to 100x, or a wild that moves every spin. Golden eggs go bigger: 5–15 spins, a wild with up to 20x, or a prize up to 2,000x. Hens keep laying in the bonus too. 96.55% RTP. Silly and fun.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
